home.hero_subtitle: Report potholes, track repairs, and make our city safer — one report at a time.
home.how_it_works_desc: Follow these steps to submit an official road damage report to your local authority.
home.step_1_body: Find a dangerous road condition anywhere in Karachi.
home.step_2_body: Submit your location and a photograph. Our system auto-detects nearby damage clusters.
home.step_3_body: Smart algorithm ranks severity — high-traffic danger zones get prioritised.
home.step_4_body: Administrators manage repairs and update status from Reported through Resolution.
home.cta_banner_desc: Join citizens helping fix our roads. Your complaint is recorded and acted upon by municipal authorities.

report.subtitle: Your report helps prioritize road repairs in Karachi.
report.description_placeholder: Describe the pothole — size, depth, road conditions...
report.severity_1: Minor — Small crack or surface damage
report.severity_3: Severe — Large, dangerous, vehicle damage risk
report.location_error: Could not detect location. Please try again.
report.success_message: Thank you for helping fix Karachi. Your report has been recorded.
report.cluster_note: A cluster of reports was detected nearby — your report increased the priority score!
report.tip_2: Take clear photos in good lighting
report.tip_3: Include something for scale if possible
report.tip_4: Add a landmark for easy identification
report.tip_5: Rate severity honestly — it helps prioritisation
report.cluster_bonus_desc: Multiple reports in the same area automatically increase the priority score, making repairs happen faster!
